Summary: Bread is God's daily provision, from manna in the wilderness to the prayer 'give us this day our daily bread.' Jesus multiplied loaves for hungry crowds and then declared, 'I am the Bread of Life,' giving His own body as food for the world. At His table we remember Him and are nourished by grace until He comes again.
KeyPassages: Exodus 16:4; Deuteronomy 8:3; Matthew 6:11; John 6:35; John 6:51; 1 Corinthians 11:23-26
RelatedEvents: Wilderness Wanderings; The Feeding of the Five Thousand; The Last Supper
